scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:digital && npm run typecheck:homomorphism
scripts.verify: npm run arch --silent && npm run typecheck --silent && npm run bundle:check --silent && node test/ast_conformance.mjs && node test/run_guards.mjs && npm run garde:documentaires --silent && npm run garde:source-voisine --silent && npm run garde:carte --silent && npm run garde:assiette --silent
scripts.bundle:libs: node src/transpiler/libs-bundle.js > src/transpiler/libs-data.js.tmp && node scripts/basculer-le-paquet.mjs src/transpiler/libs-data.js.tmp && mv src/transpiler/libs-data.js.tmp src/transpiler/libs-data.js && npm run bundle:types --silent && npm run bundle:syntaxe --silent && npm run bundle:gabarits --silent
scripts.prepare: npm run bundle:libs && (npm run gate:install || true)
scripts.gate:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo "[gate] core.hooksPath=.githooks — git execute .githooks/pre-push (versionne, executable)"
scripts.bundle:types: node src/transpiler/libs-types.js > src/transpiler/libs-data.d.ts.tmp && mv src/transpiler/libs-data.d.ts.tmp src/transpiler/libs-data.d.ts
scripts.fiche:etat: node scripts/fiche-etat.mjs > baseline-status.json.tmp && mv baseline-status.json.tmp baseline-status.json
scripts.bundle:syntaxe: node src/transpiler/syntaxe-bundle.mjs > src/transpiler/syntaxe-data.js.tmp && mv src/transpiler/syntaxe-data.js.tmp src/transpiler/syntaxe-data.js
scripts.bundle:gabarits: node src/transpiler/gabarits-bundle.mjs > src/transpiler/gabarits-data.js.tmp && mv src/transpiler/gabarits-data.js.tmp src/transpiler/gabarits-data.js
